purpose: Use broad three-load CAD evidence to choose a solver; distinguish operator, representation, capacity and coverage without Hash micro-tuning.

branches.observed_pattern: FNO leads across the three loads, paired CADs, worst stress and hotspots with lower cost
branches.action: Advance FNO as working baseline; retain best Transolver comparator; verify continuous query and BC capability separately.

branches.observed_pattern: A Transolver endpoint leads full60 and does not trade away hotspots or worst cases
branches.action: Advance that measured Transolver endpoint rather than assuming a version; keep FNO comparator.

branches.observed_pattern: native25 beats grid25 and old FNO in both absolute train and new CAD accuracy
branches.action: Retain native local BC/material query; do not assign this gain to Fourier operator without controlled comparison.

branches.observed_pattern: native25 improves TRAIN only or both latent-query arms are worse than old FNO
branches.action: Do not retain a worse decoder merely for pairwise gain; preserve original FNO and investigate common representation/fit.

branches.observed_pattern: All methods fail on the same CAD/load conditions
branches.action: Prioritize common geometry/BC representation or data coverage over small optimizer sweeps.

proposed_next_discriminating_experiment.common_input: same R64 occupancy/xyz/25 conditions and PointNet32 context
proposed_next_discriminating_experiment.common_output: 16-channel latent grid plus identical native25 point query decoder
proposed_next_discriminating_experiment.capacity_rule: Precompute configurations by parameter counts only, target total trainable parameters within 5%; no accuracy-driven width selection.
proposed_next_discriminating_experiment.controls: same oldTRAIN120, scaler, loss, node exposure, seed and fixed endpoint; preserve old absolute FNO/TS results
proposed_next_discriminating_experiment.feasibility_required: Real whole-node/whole-grid gradient and peak memory on the existing 5090 within fixed budget; if infeasible record resource result without infinite architectural rescue.
proposed_next_discriminating_experiment.cost_estimate_reason: No actual run or measurement yet.
proposed_next_discriminating_experiment.qualification_limit: Common input and capacity control does not establish full optimization, unseen-CAD final qualification or arbitrary BC capability.

resource_failure_rule: PP regime 24000 missing after actual budget negative; 23166 is not substituted, and the missing endpoint is not an accuracy-based architecture rejection.
coverage_rule: Availability-conditional new20 is development evidence, sealed20DEV remains unread. If later testing coverage, nested40/80 must separately control fixed updates and per-CAD exposure.

capacity_feasibility_source_only.FNO_formula: 55300*w^2+194*w+45812; w9/modes12/4blocks; complex weights counted as real degrees
capacity_feasibility_source_only.occupancy_policy: same channel, all empty tokens retained; no official PP attention mask assumed
capacity_feasibility_source_only.time_estimate_basis: Rough extrapolation from old PP68.55minutes and grid-token size; not an actual cost measurement

next_experiment_priority.if_clear_three_load_CAD_hotspot_and_cost: First compare leader and best TS continuous query capability without retraining; use fixed metadata-selected cases/element IDs, original TET10 nodes and interior/shared-face query points.
next_experiment_priority.if_rank_close_or_reversed: Consider common input/query/roughly4.5M global-operator pair; first one real full-grid backward and memory qualification, then fixed endpoint only if qualified.
next_experiment_priority.continuous_reference_limit: TET10 interpolation of legitimately seen nodal fields is a reconstruction reference; never claim true new off-node FEM or a physical stress tensor. Node replay, arbitrary query and derivative reconstruction must be separately assessed.
next_experiment_priority.representation_limit: A mesh interpolation service and a learned direct arbitrary-query model are distinct; a point-only solver lacking a fixed-context query interface must not be advertised as having one.

continuous_query_reuse_evidence.geometry_scope: One TRAIN CAD,32cells/8faces; geometry-only45.137s; not wholeCAD field qualification
continuous_query_reuse_evidence.current_interface_gap: FNOQueryField.query requires node slice indices/features; future physical-query adapter must recompute coordinate stencils and explicitly extend native25. Static saved weights alone do not differentiate latent spatial variation.
continuous_query_reuse_evidence.producer_stencil_semantics: coverage_comparison_data producer saves bare trilinear _stencil; historical prepare_grids masked caches and generic query_grid docstring must not override actual producer mathematics.

implemented_adapter.remaining: Actual trained model/units/scaler decode, non-affine real cells/CADs, arbitrary physical point location/domain, and BC generalization qualification pending
implemented_adapter.original_FNO_grid_route: Strongest legacy FNO can reuse _stencil+query_grid directly on its fixed encoded4 output grid; new adapter is for the two latent-query arms.
